name: P4 reference (toeic-079, first TOEIC video; multi-word vocabulary)
verified: toeic-079 post data (js/data/packs/toeic.js) → narration / episode data → ElevenLabs TTS (Arthur + Ling) → cache → character alignment → words[] → assembly (one interrupted sentence cut at the next punctuation boundary, one sentence kept whole) → renderer (scene_contrast hook, two multi-word vocabulary, Quiz, 2-phrase Outro, structured series header) → reusable music / SFX mix → final MP4
acceptedBy: user, after watching toeic-079-third-render.mp4 (third render; first and second renders are superseded)
sharedCode: not listed here: shared template / pipeline code is governed by docs/p2-auto/FROZEN.json (revisions r1-generic-validation, r2-hook-system-v0, r3-part-cut-late, r4-verify-open-word, r5-multi-word-phrase, r6-handoff-boundary, r7-camera-settle-quiz-wrap, r8-series-header-content-emoji). Run all three check-freeze commands.
capabilities: phrase forms: be consumed with → was consumed with (r5)
phrase highlighting as one continuous yellow span, nothing outside it lit (r5)
handoff at the nearest punctuation boundary: `after` in narration parts (r6); a sentence with no boundary is kept whole
structured series metadata: series, seriesEpisode, contentId (r8)
seriesEpisode: explicit per-series video number, never derived from contentId (r8)
level range schema: level { min, max } shown as L2 / L1–L2 (r8)
new header rendering `series · #NN · level`; the account-row level badge is not drawn on that path (r8)
legacy header compatibility: episodes without `series` keep episodeLabel + level badge (P2, P3 unchanged) (r8)
content emoji default off, explicit exception allowContentEmoji (r8)
camera overlap fix: a camera move that overlaps a note animation runs between two constants (r7)
Quiz Chinese keep-all: a long phrase in the question no longer splits a Chinese word (r7)
phrase Outro rows: English above, Chinese below (r5); meaning title keep-all (r5)
verify-episode checks: phrase / forms yellow spans, header, content emoji, cue at the open word (r4–r8)

verification.audioMix: 6/6 pass; re-mixing the narration-only render reproduces the accepted MP4 byte for byte (sha256 equal)
verification.p2Regression: DOM snapshot + all 912 frames identical to the baseline
verification.p3Regression: DOM snapshot + all 1358 frames identical to the baseline

knownNotBlocking: Hook zh (忙著監視對手女王，結果忘了查看自己的蜂蜜銷量。) states the payoff before the English reveal.
The answer explanation wraps to a last line with a single character (查。) near the bottom of the window.
The first example sentence (In the yard, the children played a game of cat and mouse, …) is long.
The vocabulary card title breaks after '被…' (no Chinese word is split).

Removing the hook emoji shortened the hook by 91.8 px (it sat on its own third line): the first 4.7 s show the next paragraph higher, and text rounding differs by 1 px in places versus the second render.

The narration-only render, the first and second renders, docs/toeic-079-auto/mix-work/, stills/, review sheets, seam experiments and preview wavs are rebuildable or superseded and are not part of the reference.
